justification: Inspected ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/report/suggestion/SuggestionRowBean.java and SuggestionRowBuilder.java: the package contains only these two leaf UI helpers. ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/report/ReportStage.java is the only direct internal caller. SuggestionRowBuilder depends on shared types (`org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.report.Report`, `ui.report.IReportRowBean`, four shared cell classes, JavaFX), and `Report` is imported in 14 UI source files, so the package is not shown depending on less-stable, narrowly used code; this does not match an unstable-dependency smell.
